caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with a rectangular top and four cabriole legs ending in ball-and-claw feet. The table is depicted in a brown color with visible wood grain texture. The legs are slightly curved and feature intricate carved designs at the top, with a emphasis on the contours and details. The table top is flat and beveled at the edge, and the apron beneath the tabletop is plain except for two small round details that resemble decorative fasteners or nails. The composition centers the table on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorative elements in the scene. The perspective shows the table slightly from above and at an angle, allowing three legs and two sides of the table to be visible.
title: Tea Table
